input.answer: Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees, Canada, seasonally adjusted, in August 2026 were $1,354.55 per week. This is the "Industrial aggregate excluding unclassified businesses" series, the all-industries headline measure. The "including unclassified businesses" series returned null (suppressed) for every month I requested (January to August 2026, and June to August 2025), so I could not report that variant. The value is not estimated. Source: StatCan table 14-10-0220, which covers all industries.
